_comment: List-valued secrets that a single careless write can destroy.
`gcloud secrets versions add` REPLACES the whole value -- there is no append -- so
any script or person that writes without reading first deletes every other entry.
That is what happened to HUSHH_UAT_PHONE_TEST_NUMBERS on 2026-09-03: 59 entries
became 1, and nobody noticed for five days.
min_entries : below this, the list has certainly been wiped.
max_shrink  : entries that may disappear between adjacent versions before it is
flagged. Removing a departed tester is normal; losing 58 is not.
Edit these only with scripts/ops/secret_list_edit.py, which cannot shrink a list.

secrets.name: HUSHH_UAT_PHONE_TEST_NUMBERS
secrets.purpose: UAT fixed-OTP phone allowlist. Wiped 59 -> 1 on 2026-09-03; restored as version 10.
